name: Sentry
description: Sends errors from the server and from members' browsers to Sentry (sentry.io), so they can be fixed before anyone reports them.
author: Obsidian Slicers

settings.label: Server DSN
settings.help: Errors on the server go to this Sentry project. Leave empty to use SENTRY_DSN from the .env file.

settings.label: Browser DSN
settings.help: Errors in members' browsers go to this Sentry project (it can be the same one). It is visible in each page. Leave empty to use SENTRY_BROWSER_DSN from the .env file; with neither, browser errors aren't sent.

settings.label: Environment
settings.help: Shown on each error in Sentry, such as production or staging. Leave empty to use APP_ENV.

settings.label: Send browser errors through this site
settings.help: Ad blockers often block sentry.io. With this on, browsers send errors to /webhooks/sentry, which passes them on to the Browser DSN's project and nowhere else.
